sources.name: Federal Reserve Economic Data (FRED)
sources.note: FRED hosts series produced by several agencies (BLS, BEA, Census). Each series records its own originating agency where FRED supplies it.
sources.publisher: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis
sources.update_frequency: Daily pipeline run; individual series update on their own publication schedules.

sources.name: American Community Survey 5-Year Estimates
sources.note: 5-year rolling estimates. Dollar values are expressed in the vintage's inflation-adjusted dollars and are not comparable across vintages.
sources.update_frequency: Annual vintage; checked weekly by the pipeline.
